plain_statement: KM0: AND/OR gates listing two earlier wires each, on N point and N line inputs, each AND with a line-free input or two point-free ones. Assume the KM0 flag and normal-form lemma. Let C be KM0, false with all points and no line on. Cone gates: gates below the output reading points and lines (mixed). No cone OR has a line-free input. Over input positions of cone gates: #cone ORs + #cone gates = #positions with a point-free wire + #positions with a mixed wire, and #cone gates <= the second number + 1.
